content:
SpaceXAI and Cursor are merging into one company, but before that happens, the two companies have already launched a brand new iPhone and Mac app called Grok Bot.

According to SpaceXAI's announcement, Grok Bot is a new type of AI agent, which they describe as "AI teammates you can give real work to".

Each Bot will have its own computer, then log into apps and services you already use, to handle work ranging from inbox to other tools.

SpaceXAI says Bots can complete work end-to-end, only checking back when approval is needed.

You can talk to them "like chatting with a colleague", the company says, and this agent will remember conversations, learn your preferences, and get better the more you use it.

Grok Bot launched today in beta on Mac and iOS. Windows and Linux desktop versions are also available. Android is listed as coming soon.

Initially limited to subscribers of SuperGrok Heavy, Cursor Ultra, and Cursor Teams Premium.

You can learn more from the official announcement here.

21 August 2026: SpaceXAI expanded Grok Bot's reach 10 days in.

Meanwhile, my colleague Fernando sounds like a fan. Sounds like SpaceXAI and Cursor have indeed designed an approachable agentic AI system — other companies should really consider following suit.
